name: Get full text
description: Fetches the full text of the judgments a search found, from Rechtspraak or the ECHR, so they can be annotated. Shows which ones have no published text. With persistent data, the judgments are saved as documents.

config.label: Most judgments to fetch
config.help: Fetching text is one request per ten judgments, so a search with hundreds of results would take a while. The first ones the search returns are fetched.
